package.name: pcd_to_pgm
package.description: PointCloud2 + TF -> Nav2 2-D map (pgm/yaml) in the Odin1 map frame. Incremental log-odds mapper with vectorised Bresenham ray tracing, plus an offline --compare mode (occupancy recall / free-area error / connectivity) against a truth map. Pure numpy on the ROS side: Humble and Jazzy.
